fields.label: Financial covenants
fields.value: The Company is required to maintain a minimum fixed charge coverage ratio of 1.25 to 1.00, measured quarterly on a trailing twelve-month basis, and a maximum senior leverage ratio of 3.50 to 1.00 stepping down to 3.25 to 1.00 for fiscal quarters ending after December 31, 2025. As of June 30, 2025, the Company was in compliance with all covenants, except as described in Note 9, for which the lender granted a waiver dated August 4, 2025.

HALVORSEN MARINE SUPPLY, LLC AND SUBSIDIARY
Consolidated Financial Statements
for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2025
with Independent Auditor's Report

INDEPENDENT AUDITOR'S REPORT
To the Members of Halvorsen Marine Supply, LLC
Opinion: We have audited the accompanying consolidated financial statements... In our opinion, the financial statements present fairly, in all material respects, the financial position of the Company as of June 30, 2025...

CONSOLIDATED STATEMENT OF OPERATIONS
(in thousands of U.S. dollars)
Net sales 48,213
Cost of goods sold 36,904
Gross profit 11,309
Selling, general and administrative 6,429
Operating income 4,880
Interest expense 1,512
Income before taxes 3,368
Income tax expense 1,464
Net income 1,904

Supplemental (non-GAAP):
Adjusted EBITDA (see Note 7) 6,120

CONSOLIDATED BALANCE SHEET
(in thousands of U.S. dollars)
Cash and equivalents 3,215
Accounts receivable, net 7,842
Inventory 12,906
Total current assets 24,388
...
Current portion of long-term debt 3,250
Total long-term debt 21,500
Total members' equity 18,077

NOTE 7 — ADJUSTED EBITDA
Adjusted EBITDA is a non-GAAP measure defined as operating income plus depreciation and amortization (1,034), plus one-time restructuring costs (206). Management believes this measure... EBITDA as defined under the Credit Agreement excludes restructuring add-backs and was 5,914 for the year.

NOTE 8 — DEBT AND COVENANTS
(in thousands of U.S. dollars)
Term loan 18,000
Revolving line of credit 6,750
Total debt, including current portion 24,750
Scheduled principal and interest payments, next twelve months 4,310
The Company is required to maintain a minimum fixed charge coverage ratio of 1.25 to 1.00... As of June 30, 2025, the Company was in compliance with all covenants, except as described in Note 9, for which the lender granted a waiver dated August 4, 2025.

NOTE 9 — SUBSEQUENT EVENTS
In Q4 the Company did not meet the minimum fixed charge coverage ratio. The lender waived this event of default on August 4, 2025.
